verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. 'WEEKEND ONLY' sits far above '20% off', and the subcopy floats above and to the right of the headline, so the reading order is jumbled. The CTA drifts in its own middle column away from the headline, and the legal line is unreadably tiny under the product circle. A's middle column hugs the headline unevenly, while B's subcopy and button sit slightly more centred in the gap, so B is marginally better balanced.
